comment: Independent C-first elven Wizard with IBMgraphics and msg_window:reversed. ';' farlooks the floor north of the hero, whose putmixed() line opens with the IBM room byte 0xFA. Ctrl-P (step 10) shows it in the Message History window: wintty.c process_text_window() sends that first byte through g_putch(), whose recorder hook stores it one column right, where the following space overwrites it, so column 0 of the row stays blank.
